text: Welcome to the lab workspace. Lab meeting is every Thursday at 10:00 in seminar room 2.
Summer interns start on Monday. I will run the first training session, on command line basics.
Second training session for the interns is on Wednesday: read QC and what the plots mean.
Last training session for the interns is this Friday. After that they present their projects.
The move off the old Tapti cluster is finished. Everything now runs on Kaveri.
The bio-142 allocation on Kaveri is renewed once a year. I have done the renewal for the last two years.
Poster for the Soil Microbiome Symposium is printed. Thanks Tara for the figures.
Biosafety committee approval for the isolate work has to be renewed every year.
This year the biosafety renewal is due 3 December 2026. I checked last year's letter.
Our contact at the sequencing core is Dr. Joseph Mathew. Email joseph.mathew@genomicscore.example, phone +91 90220 00173.

Reminder: the minus 80 freezer check is once a week, and whoever does it signs the log.
The freezer log sheet is on the clipboard on the freezer door in room B-114. I keep the scanned copies.
If the minus 80 stays above -60 C for more than a few hours we lose the isolate stocks.
